thought.text: API baca jalan. Sekarang tes yang sebenarnya: **jalankan notebook dengan GPU** untuk membuktikan GPU-nya hidup.

action.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export KAGGLE_API_TOKEN="KGAT_60050eb732f8deb448367144c378a69c"; mkdir -p /workspace/project/kgtest && cd /workspace/project/kgtest && cat > test.py <<'EOF'
import json,subprocess,os
out={"ok":True}
try:
    out["nvidia_smi"]=subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version","--format=csv,noheader"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
except Exception as e: out["nvidia_smi_err"]=str(e)
try:
    import torch
    out["torch"]=torch.__version__; out["cuda_avail"]=torch.cuda.is_available()
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        out["gpu_name"]=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)
        a=torch.randn(2000,2000,device="cuda"); b=a@a; out["matmul_ok"]=bool(torch.isfinite(b).all())
except Exception as e: out["torch_err"]=str(e)
open("/kaggle/working/gpu_check.json","w").write(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
EOF
